summary: Enerflex Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release announcing the award of a major Engineered Systems project to design, engineer, fabricate and assemble approximately 450 MW of behind-the-meter natural gas-fired power generation units for a North American data center developer. Deliveries begin 2027 and complete 2028. No price, stake, premium or counterparty is disclosed. The company authorized roughly $85 million of ES facility investment plus about $15 million of 2026 capex. This is an ordinary commercial contract award, not a special situation; watch execution and capacity ramp.
